listing.description:
Stronger Weeks is an undated digital fitness planner for your tablet. Plan each week, log every workout, plan your meals and see your progress, all linked together. Start any day, in any month.

What's inside: 344 portrait pages in one PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section on one screen
- Start here: 4 numbered steps, each with a Go there button
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device, with a fix list if one does not jump
- 52 weeks overview: a card for every week, tap to open it
- 52 week pages: dates, a day table (workout plan, minutes, done), a 7-day habit tracker (water, steps, sleep, protein, stretching and 2 rows of your own), weigh-in, win of the week and next week's plan
- 208 workout pages, 4 for each week: date, focus, minutes, effort 1 to 5, 8 exercises with a Last time column and 4 sets, a cardio table, how it felt and next time
- 9 training log pages: every workout listed by week, one tap to open each
- 52 meal plan pages, one for each week: breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for 7 days with a tick for each meal you ate as planned, a grocery list in 5 groups and a prep ahead box
- Progress: a 52-week weight chart, start and goal, milestones and wins the scale does not show
- Measurements: weight, chest, waist, hips, thigh and arm at the start and every 4 weeks, a change row and a how to measure guide
- 13 undated month pages (January to December plus Month 13, for a year that starts mid-month): goal, workouts done, 31 day circles to tick on workout days, energy colors for each day and a monthly reflection
- 3 dot grid notes pages

Good to know: a digital PDF for note apps on a tablet. Portrait only, undated, in English. No stickers. It is not a fillable form: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool.

What makes it different
- One week, one tap. Each week page has buttons to that week's meal plan and Workout 1 to 4, and each of those has a Week button back. Nothing to duplicate: all 52 weeks are already in the file.
- Workout logs that help you get stronger. Write last time's best set next to each exercise, then try to beat it.
- A year of progress on one page. Plot one dot a week on the weight chart and watch the line. Week 4, 8, 12 and so on show a Measure button.
- Start any day. No dates are printed, so you can begin on a Tuesday in October or on the first of June and nothing is wasted.
- Working in five minutes. The Open planner button on the cover takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work before you write anything.
- Each week's pages sit together: the week, its meal plan and its 4 workouts, 6 pages in a row. Swipe through one week at a time.
- Easy to get around: month tabs on every page, a top bar for Home, Weeks, Workouts and Progress, and on every page arrows and a trail at the top right that works as a back button.
- A calm, athletic look: soft white pages, deep navy text, one cobalt accent, and text that stays crisp at any zoom.

Works with
- Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf
- on iPad, Android tablets and Windows tablets
You need a PDF note app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages.

Not for
- Phones: the pages are tablet size
- Files, Photos and other file viewers: they show the pages but do not follow the links
- Canva, spreadsheets or fillable forms: this is a PDF you write on by hand or with your app's text tool

Want paper too? Every page is 8 x 10.7 inches, smaller than US Letter and A4, so it fits on Letter at Actual size. On A4, choose Fit to page so the month tabs at the edge print too. A week's 6 pages are in a row, so you can print one week as a single page range. The soft page color prints too.

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your note app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then open Week 1, write the dates and plan your first week.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF note app: Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Noteshelf.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes.
- I train more than 4 times a week. Write the extra sessions in that week's day table, or log them on a Notes page.
- Kilograms or pounds? Either. You write your own units and your own scale on the chart.

What you get
- Stronger-Weeks.pdf (8.3 MB, 344 pages, portrait)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
The Setup check page has a fix list. Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.
